name: Agentcard
description: Issue virtual Visa cards for AI agents. Fund a card with a fixed USD budget, hand the credentials to an agent via MCP, and spend anywhere Visa is accepted. Single-use by design — the blast radius of any misstep is capped at the card balance.

capabilities.name: Virtual card issuance
capabilities.description: Create a single-use virtual Visa card funded with a fixed USD amount.

capabilities.name: Card payment
capabilities.description: Authorize a payment using an issued Agentcard on any site that accepts Visa.

capabilities.name: Balance inquiry
capabilities.description: Check the remaining balance on any issued card without exposing credentials.

capabilities.name: Support chat
capabilities.description: Start and continue a support conversation from inside an agent runtime.

skills.name: Create virtual card
skills.description: Create a new virtual Visa card funded with a specified USD amount.
examples: Create a $25 card for this checkout

skills.name: List virtual cards
skills.description: List all cards with balance, status, last four digits, and expiry.

skills.name: Get card credentials
skills.description: Return the PAN, CVV, and expiry for a card (may require user approval).

skills.name: Close virtual card
skills.description: Permanently close a card so it can no longer be used.

skills.name: Start support chat
skills.description: Open a new support conversation with Agentcard.

skills.name: Send support message
skills.description: Send a message inside an existing support conversation.

skills.name: Read support chat
skills.description: Read the history of a support conversation.
